text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — post-launch follow-on planning for the file-search release. want to align on bugs vs enhancements for next 2 sprints. customers found 3 regressions and a few UX asks.
Ryan Kim: solid. can we list top customer impacts and pick which are blocking? I think we should treat data-loss/regression as P0.
Maya Patel: agreed. list: 1) missing results for exact phrase queries (reported by Acme) 2) intermittent 504s under load 3) search relevance drift on punctuation 4) suggestion UI flicker on mobile
Anna Chen: rough effort: (1) 3 dev-days, (2) needs infra runbook + 2 dev-days, (3) 1 dev-day + eval, (4) 1/2 day
Samir Gupta: for 504s need a small autoscale tweak + investigate batching — ops estimate 2-3 days. recommend canary for fix
Ivy Lee: UI flicker is low effort but high perception; design can ship small fix this sprint
Luis Torres: customer severity: Acme and BetaCorp marked (1) as P0. multiple others P2. I'll surface in CS notes
Maya Patel: proposal — Sprint A (next): address (1) and (2) as hotfixes (P0). Sprint B: work on (3) relevance tuning + (4) UI polish as enhancements. Also reserve a day for rollbacks/monitoring
Ryan Kim: +1. also add an eval job for relevance regression (automated test with 200 prompts). can we add to the board as: `hotfix/phrase-results`, `hotfix/504-scale`, `enh/relevance-tune`, `enh/ui-mobile-fix`
Anna Chen: I suggest pairing (1) with a small rollout policy: sample 20% traffic to new query parser. if green, ramp to 100% in 24h
Maya Patel: good. acceptance criteria for (1): exact-phrase recall >= 99% on Acme testset, no increase in latency >10ms
Samir Gupta: ops checklist:
```
- canary 20% traffic
- tracing enabled for query path
- auto rollback at 2x error rate
- perf dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/boards/search
```
Anna Chen: estimate: hotfix work + QA = 5 dev-days total if we parallelize
Luis Torres: i'll schedule customer callbacks after canary ramp; cs will flag if any regression seen
Ivy Lee: will drop a quick design patch and a gif to show change
Maya Patel: decision: move hotfixes to next sprint A, add enh backlog items to sprint B, set a follow-up checkpoint 72h after hotfix rollout. owners: Anna (eng), Samir (ops), Ivy (design), Ryan (pm), Luis (cs)
ops-bot: Deployment scheduled by Anna Chen at 2025-05-18T10:00:00Z (canary 20%) :rocket:
Ryan Kim: I'll create the JIRA tickets and link here. Anyone object?
Anna Chen: no objections. thanks — will post timeline in #eng-releases
Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll send updated roadmap slice doc and sync notes after stand.
